collection.stopped: verifyReceipt: expected providerRequestHashes must be a non-empty ordered array of SHA-256 digests

termination.reason: Conservative remaining budget cannot reserve the next GPT-4.1-mini request. Paid evaluation stopped; uncertain charges were not released.
harnessDefectsFound: After first network timeout, the measured version kept trying subsequent cases, consuming conservative reservations. Fixed to halt on the first unknown transport failure.

After a budget denial, zero observed HTTP calls were passed as an invalid empty expected request-hash array. This interrupted row persistence. Fixed to compare configured-fetch preparations and omit an empty expectation.
termination.missingFinalRow: The final case failed before HTTP egress due to budget denial; no additional paid request was made.
termination.reporting: Keep original measurements and stop reason unchanged. Do not pool development smoke cases with heldout evaluation. No hosted latency, support/completeness, or answer-correctness score is established by this run.

judge.limitation: One fixed GPT-4.1-mini judge; no human labels. ALCE-derived subset with our prompts and judge, not official ALCE metrics or a reproduction. Judge errors and shared-model bias remain possible.

method.latency: Only runtime-successful measured latency rows with finite nonnegative wall/provider/processing timings. Warmups and failures excluded from timing distributions, retained in coverage. Processing is wall minus HTTP and backoff, not a causal pure-SDK cost.

bootstrap.interval: 95% percentile bootstrap of the median, resampling cases within model/arm; n<2 has no CI

method.citationDenominator: 60 per model/arm, including unattempted, blocked, invalid and unjudged cases. Claim metrics are conditional micro-aggregates over valid judgments. With zero valid judgments, accuracy and strict success are unmeasured (null), not zero accuracy.
method.strictCitationSuccess: Usable runtime output, valid judge, correct non-abstained answer, nonempty claims, every claim supported/cited, and every claimed citation relevant.
method.transport: Task correctness and observed request image parts do not attest that the remote receiver consumed specific bytes.
method.privacy: Checks supplied markers only; blocked answers and absent receipts are not counted as delivered leak-free answers.
method.historical: Historical results use different extraction/scoring and are not directly comparable.

preregisteredPromotion.primaryMetric: macro one-to-one exact-span F1 across four mapped types
preregisteredPromotion.gate: macro F1 increases and no type loses more than 0.01 absolute exact-span precision; default promotion additionally requires supportive development evidence
preregisteredPromotion.developmentEvidence: Candidate has slightly lower macro F1 on development; retain opt-in regardless of a tiny heldout delta. No post-holdout tuning.

holdout.decision: Keep contextual detection opt-in; no default promotion.

pii.interpretation: Corpus annotation agreement, not estimated deployment precision. Four supported PII types; prose rows do not measure structured-field cues. Historical single-match and many-to-one span scores are not comparable.

methodology.commonRecord: All arms store the complete identical canonical Lattice receipt body, including every task, policy, input, output, and request digest. Raw synthetic values are committed by hashes in every arm.
methodology.signing: Both signed arms use the same ephemeral Ed25519 key. The generic log signs its domain prefix plus canonical record bytes using node:crypto; Lattice signs its DSSE PAE. Private keys are never saved.
methodology.mutations: Integrity probes change the same record bytes or fields without updating either signature. The byte edit preserves valid JSON; JSON parsing failures are not counted as integrity protection.
methodology.expectationPolicy: Generic and unsigned logs receive matching explicit application equality checks; Lattice uses VerifyOptions. Base signature/parse acceptance is reported separately from expectation acceptance. Unsigned equality does not authenticate the asserted fields.
methodology.interpretation: A trusted signer can rewrite and re-sign records; both signed formats should accept that positive control. Signatures do not establish factual correctness, policy enforcement, real model execution, or provider consumption. No truncation/chain completeness claim is tested.
methodology.aggregation: Category counts retain controls, expectation checks, and unsupported key checks separately. asExpected measures benchmark correctness, not model quality or comparative security superiority.

methodology.matching: Official UTF-16 normalization, span deduplication, source-label mapping, and deterministic one-to-one maximum-cardinality overlap matching. Reproduced TP/FP/FN counts are asserted against pii_metrics.score; metrics are unchanged.
methodology.partition: Every unmatched prediction belongs to exactly one bucket: overlaps same-type gold but loses one-to-one matching; overlaps only other annotated labels; or overlaps no annotation of any type.
methodology.repeatedStrings: Case-sensitive exact equality with a complete annotated span at another non-overlapping location in the same document. Counts are cross-tabulated by unmatched bucket; values are never exported.
methodology.interpretation: No-overlap predictions repeating a same-type annotated string are potential annotation gaps, not automatically true positives. Other-label overlaps may reflect taxonomy disagreements, boundaries, or detector mistakes. Unannotated strings without this evidence remain unexplained by this analysis.
methodology.privacy: Only aggregate counts, metrics, and file-level provenance hashes are published. No raw text, matched values, document IDs, individual offsets, or per-value hashes are emitted. Only the fixed development files are read.

developmentSpotcheck.scope: qualitative AI-reviewed development only; excluded from numerical accuracy and heldout metrics
